author: Frosty
text:
@ bro Dengaima, Thanks for your reply, bro. I know that nothing worthwhile in this life comes easy. Trading has been a passion for me in life. It has become almost an obsession. I'm stepping back again to relax and then restart.

I think could be of any use in RTM at the moment since the concepts are still floating without form in my mind, so that's why I chose not to renew my subscription right away. I think the constant information will distract me rather than do me good.

As a reply to your comment about the information served on a golden plate, The many eureka moments would be lost and everything would be taken for granted.

We are trading against traders in the end, so I guess if we are taking money from people, this stuff should be obscured from the world.

But I'm still betting that lazy people stay lazy. Serve lazy people awesome information on a golden platter and they will still just chuck it out the window. Again, that's just my opinion.

I agree with you that we should find our own way, and this is what I will do now.

Maybe there is still some psychological issue left in me that needs to be solved away from trading Thank you for the well wishes, brother. I wish the same good things to you too @bro Full, Thank you for your guidance, brother Quite the contrary, I found RTM to be the best community and resource to learn about trading, compared to what I have experienced in the past I'm just saying it could benefit from placing important things in a single thread (but again, that is just my personal opinion).

I understand that RTM is all we need. I'm not looking for another "system" or "method".

I'm still in the process of fitting everything together and might not be a useful resource in this community, at least for now.

Definitely a rest is needed and I believe it will come together in the end, no matter how slow Again, thank you for your guidance brother!

author: Rinehart
text:
Frosty, I want to echo what Full posted.

You are correct that the information presented here could be distilled down and presented better. I recognize how frustrating it is trying to find an answer to one question and accidentally creating more questions. I won't comment on this fact.

What I will say is that I have been on dozens of other sites over the years. I have spent the time and money searching and I still didn't find true gold here but it has to be mined. It is difficult work and many will miss the nuggets but they are here.

I too have considered quitting over the years. Take some time off. It will actually do your brain some good. Some concepts conceptualize better with time. I hope to see you back soon though. I think you have what it takes. Just recognize forex is not get rich soon. All the full time traders I know took years (4 - 8) to achieve full time trading and account growth they could live on.

Ryan

author: Frosty
text:
Thank you bro Ryan for your guidance About searching on other sites for how to trade, I've been down that road as well and, really, I truly believe the information in RTM is enough to be a good trader. I've proven RTM concepts for myself during my chart study periods that price reading that we are taught in RTM works. Translating them into proper trading habits, on the other hand, is like the distance between mars and earth, at least for me personally I guess I just need some time off, then lots of screen time to make these knowledge instinctive I understand that anything of great value can't be mastered in a matter of days or weeks.

I'll definitely work hard to find what I'm missing (both technically or psychologically), and when I know what I'm talking about in a definite way (not the weird posts I've been posting around lately), I will come back to share As I said, I'm forever indebted to all of you, especially IF, for sharing your knowledge. I want to be able to return something to the community other than unimportant ramblings Thanks again, bro Ryan!

author: moneydeep
text:
I would just like to add to what others have said. The truth is in here but it's just behind a lot of posts. Having it completely centralised has advantages and disadvantages. It makes it easier to learn but also easier for people to come and steal RTM materials.

It's been almost 6 months for me here at RTM and I have learned somuch and have had a many great trades followed by bad ones too. I have not reached that stage where I am comfortable with my trading on a constant basis. I spend many hours on the charts and I have eureka moments followed by moments of disdain followed by another eureka moment a few days later. As Reinhart said sometimes fresh eyes helps. I'm hopefully planning to go to Europe for a couple months vacation and looking at the I have spent almost 10 years on and off in forex going through various systems and strategies and RTM has been the closest to the truth of the market and it's movements. I have realized it is not a sprint but a marathon so I'm willing to give it a year or two and not rush it.

Wish you all the best and hope you come back with a great eureka moment.

author: Enkim
text: Hi Frosty, its too bad you are (hopefuly temporarily) quitting, i am used to read your posts, and i truly believe you will be missed here, at least by me. On the other hand i understand you. If i can give you one last suggestion I will tell you how i managed to learn RTM:) I believe that the most effective way is not reading everything on this wonderful site all over again. Just read marketpedia, IFs journal and few others and then close explorer, open your charts and get that many time said screen time. I mean not few hours, but many many more. Just try to understand how price move by yourself, try to read FLs, find engulfs and so on, but only by you. You will develop some theories, after that you will reject them, you will notice patterns, those you can backtest and find out that they are not working, but you notice other things and so on. I think even in this stage you can be in profit. Becouse everything is in the charts. BTW even IF got his knowlage from charts only. After this stage you can compare what you have learned with others here in forum, but you will have your own trading plan already created so there will be less confusion i think. May be what is working for me will not work for you, but at least you have some alternative:) Just dont quit trading, i believe you have put in effort and it would be waste to throw it away, dont you think? I wish you the best! Enkim
